name: example-oci-cloud-guard
note: Reference mapping for an Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Cloud Guard problems export (MCE-06). Records have the published ProblemSummary shape (a ProblemCollection `items` array). The status is read from lifecycleDetail, the published substate: OPEN is a problem the source still reports (FAIL); RESOLVED, DISMISSED and DELETED are UNKNOWN, never PASS, because a problems export states no pass (a resolved problem is re-checked by the source, a dismissed one was closed by a person). The coarse lifecycleState (ACTIVE, INACTIVE) is not read. Each problem is one resource, so id is the per-record identity (AUD-F77); it and the compartment OCID become opaque ids before export. The first entry of `regions` is the location (the single `region` field is documented as deprecated). Rule-to-KSI bindings are the provider's declaration, for illustration only.
